candidate_diagnostics.interpretation: Separate intrusive Python diagnostic, including candidate installation and continuous runs. Exceptions may be intentionally handled; False returns may be normal predicates. These are source locations for investigation, not proof of failure or causal attribution. Only candidate installer files on the worker's current Python thread are traced; native code and other threads are outside this observation. Propagated exception tracebacks can locate imported helpers without tracing their execution or retaining frames/locals.
